test_case_name: Accept all cookies and verify banner closure on Operazioni di cessione page

intents.intent: Click 'Acconsento' on the Operazioni di cessione page
And then check that the cookie banner is closed

And then check that the Privacy - Cookie policy page is displayed

test_case_name: Open and use desktop search on Operazioni di cessione page

intents.intent: Click 'Search' button on the Operazioni di cessione page
Type $name into 'Cosa posso fare per te oggi?' input field
Click 'Cerca (desktop)' button
And then check that the search results for $name are displayed

test_case_name: Reset desktop search field on Operazioni di cessione page

intents.intent: Click 'Search' button on the Operazioni di cessione page
Type $name into 'Cosa posso fare per te oggi?' input field
Click 'Reset ricerca (desktop)' button
And then check that the search input field is cleared

test_case_name: Perform mobile search on Operazioni di cessione page

intents.intent: Type $name into 'Cerca' input field
Click 'Cerca (mobile)' button
And then check that the search results for $name are displayed

test_case_name: Login as guest user on Operazioni di cessione page

intents.intent: Type $email into 'E-mail' input field
Type $name into 'Password' input field
Click 'ENTRA' button
And then check that the guest user is logged in

test_case_name: Login as guest user and enable 'Mantieni L'accesso' on Operazioni di cessione page

intents.intent: Type $email into 'E-mail' input field
Type $name into 'Password' input field
Click 'Mantieni L'accesso' checkbox
Click 'ENTRA' button
And then check that the guest user is logged in and the session is persistent
